newsitem.title: USA: Shawnee to merge with WesBanco subsidiary.
newsitem.headline: Shawnee to merge with WesBanco subsidiary.

text.p: WesBanco Inc and Shawnee Bank Inc said Friday they had entered into a definitive agreement to merge Shawnee into a unit of WesBanco.
The banks said in a joint statement Shawnee would merge into WesBanco Bank South Hills, a wholly-owned subsidiary of WesBanco, in a transaction worth about $9.9 million.
Shawnee shareholders would receive 10.094 shares of WesBanco common stock for each share of Shawnee common stock, they said.
The banks said they expected the merger to close in the third quarter of 1997.
Shawnee, which has assets totalling about $38.6 million, operates one bank with two offices located in South Charleston and Dunbar, Kanawha County, W.Va.
WesBanco, with consolidated assets of some $1.6 billion, operates two offices of WesBanco Bank South Hills in Charleston and Sissonville, Kanawha County, West Virginia.
WesBanco also operates four banks and a mortgage company in West Virginia with 34 offices, and one bank in Ohio with five offices.
